english.notes:
(i) This offence applies from 4am on 5th January 2023.
(ii) Please note - whilst this is a summary offence, the offence is not governed by the 6 month time limit that would usually apply to offences as set out in section 127(1) of the Magistrates Court Act 1980. This is because the offence is created by regulations made under the Public Health (Control of Disease) Act 1984. Section 64A of the Public Health (Control of Disease) Act 1984 provides the time limits for this offence, being before the end of the period of 6 months beginning with the date on which evidence which the prosecutor thinks is sufficient to justify the proceedings comes to the prosecutor's knowledge; and within 3 years of the date of the commission of the offence.
(iii) Proceedings for this offence may be brought by the Civil Aviation Authority (see regulation 10).
